objective: Frozen exploratory census over the 3-net laws (three sorts, z = x o y) of Latin squares: the groups Z2, Z3, Z4, Z2xZ2, Z5, Z6, S3, Z7 and Z2xZ4, the non-group isotopy class of order 5, and non-group squares of orders 6 and 7; the overlapping knots e = x + yH over Z5 and Z7 and the equality indicator; controls parity and the Boolean neither-knot. For each law: elimination on random sort-respecting systems of up to eight variables and on fixed gadgets (a 2x2 subsquare with a shared diagonal label, a three-cycle of shared labels); collapse of the candidate tops; for laws without a failure, the top lemma, tie and knot top images, and a ternary polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops on knot ranges.
status: Closed: supported in part by KNOT-IMAGES-20261021-001A-E001 (exploratory; signal false because H5 failed; H1-H4, H2b, H6 and all four controls hold; the independent check re-verified every square, failure, collapse, table and certificate and replicated the counts on 200 fresh systems per surviving law). Every non-group Latin square's 3-net law fails (seven on the shared-diagonal gadget) or collapses its tops (the scoping survivor of order 6). The 3-nets of the abelian p-groups Z2, Z3, Z4, Z2xZ2, Z5, Z7, Z8 and Z2xZ4 have no failure, with tops the cosets of the maximal fully invariant subgroup; those of Z6, S3 and D4 collapse; that of Q8 has neither, with top Q8/{+-1}. Every overlapping knot (e = x + yH over Z5 and Z7, the equality indicator) fails. All 65,159 knot top images in surviving laws (12,036 systems) are functional, no circuit hides and every tie is a bijection. H5 failed on Q8 alone: its search for a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops timed out at 1200 seconds, and ticket B shows that none exists.
title: Census: overlapping and non-group Latin knots
